name: bifrost-heroku
description: Root package for Heroku Node buildpack — builds the Bifrost UI before the Go binary.

scripts.heroku-postbuild: npm ci --prefix ui --include=dev && npm run build-enterprise --prefix ui && rm -rf transports/bifrost-http/ui && mkdir -p transports/bifrost-http/ui && cp -R ui/out/. transports/bifrost-http/ui/
